references.text: The sin offering with one male goat is prescribed as part of the monthly and festival offerings, just as in Num 29:25.
The daily burnt offering (עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד) along with its accompanying grain offering and drink offering mentioned as the basis for the additional offerings.
Parallel wording for the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the same sin offering provision.
Parallel wording for the third day of the Feast of Tabernacles with an identical sin offering provision.
Parallel wording for the fourth day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the same sin offering provision.
Basic provisions concerning the Feast of Tabernacles lasting seven days, where Num 29:25 applies to the fifth day.
The original command regarding the daily burnt offering that was to be performed continuously, referred to as עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד.
